headline: Mexican peso loses 25 centavos against the dollar; closes at 19.42 units
summary: The peso touched its weakest level in 16 months and closed at 19.42 per dollar, even as the dollar retreated. Expectations of a narrowing interest rate differential with the United States weighed on the currency.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency and is sensitive to interest rate gaps with the US, which drive carry trade flows. Currency moves affect inflation, corporate dollar debt and import costs.
why_moved: The peso fell despite a weaker dollar, as expectations of a smaller interest rate differential with the United States reduced its yield appeal.
original_headline: Peso mexicano pierde 25 centavos frente al dólar; cierra en 19.42 unidades
